_title: 4422 Massive Exploration — Production Config (PT, 10 chains, NPA1→NPA2)
_search_space: NPA1→NPA2: N=40 candidate moments. At k=20: C(40,20) ≈ 1.4×10^11. Total: 2^40 ≈ 1.1 trillion.
_eval_budget: 10 chains × 20 epochs × 50 steps/epoch = 10,000 SDP evaluations per (expression, k, seed).

_pt_rationale.num_chains_10: 10 replicas span a wide T-range with frequent inter-chain swaps.
_pt_rationale.T_min_0.05: Cold chain near optima. Bell cost deltas ~0.05; T=0.05 gives acceptance exp(-1)≈37% — selective but not frozen.
_pt_rationale.T_max_2.0: Hot chain accepts essentially any swap in the N=40 space.
_pt_rationale.steps_per_epoch_50: N=40 mixes well with 50 Metropolis steps per epoch.
_pt_rationale.num_epochs_20: 20 swap rounds give good propagation through the temperature ladder.
_pt_rationale.num_seeds_15: 15 independent restarts for robust landscape sampling.

_comment_error_to_stop: Stop k-loop when |best_k - ref| / ref < 0.1 (within 10% of reference). Set null to run all k values.
